concept: Cocktail toast in a surreal parlour
creativeDirection: Location photography in a real domestic interior, using a recognisable living-room place restaged with a few surreal physical objects and one sharply lit cast portrait.
scene: A warmly lit old living room at nightfall, viewed from eye level at conversational distance. The room has pale wooden floorboards, a sofa, a fireplace, a television set, framed pictures, and bay windows gone dark outside. In the near middle ground stands the man from source 1, in his suit, smiling and raising a cocktail glass toward the camera as if making a toast. Around him, the room itself carries the week’s other motifs as plausible objects: a freestanding door standing oddly near the fireplace, a swallow ornament in flight, a large framed eye on the wall, and a sepia world-map design painted directly onto part of the floorboards like an old decorative floorcloth.

elements.element: the suited man raising a cocktail glass
the sunlit-style domestic living room rebuilt as the location, with sofa, fireplace, television, bay windows, framed pictures, wooden floorboards, and scattered glassware
a freestanding interior door placed near the fireplace
a large framed eye hung among the room’s pictures
a swallow ornament suspended or mounted near the ceiling line
a sepia world-map floorcloth or painted map section across part of the wooden floor
small accents of black, white, and muted pink in upholstery and trim
blue-grey night tones at the windows

coverSummaries.album: 20th Century Paddy The Songs Of Shane MacGowan
coverSummaries.description: A black-and-white portrait of a man in a suit occupies the lower center, smiling and holding up a cocktail glass toward the viewer. Behind him is a dense collage of white chalk-like drawings, handwritten scrawls, cartoon figures, symbols, faces, objects, and doodles on a black background.
coverSummaries.signatureMotif: man in a suit raising a cocktail glass before a wall of doodles
coverSummaries.people: one man in a suit holding up a cocktail glass
coverSummaries.place: A dark interior-like backdrop completely covered with chalk-style drawings and scribbles, with no clear architectural features visible.

coverSummaries.description: A close rear view of a shirtless person shows their bare back and neck centered in the frame, with a large tattoo across the shoulders. The image is bordered by ornate black-and-white illustrated flowers and roses.
coverSummaries.signatureMotif: bare back with large shoulder tattoo framed by flowers
coverSummaries.people: one person seen from behind with a bare back and short dyed hair

coverSummaries.description: A soft outdoor portrait shows two men from the chest up against a blurred blue-grey background. The man on the left wears round glasses and a dark green shirt, facing sideways; the man on the right wears a dark open-collar shirt and looks slightly upward.
coverSummaries.signatureMotif: two men posed against a blurred sky-like background
coverSummaries.people: two men standing side by side, one in glasses looking left and one looking upward
coverSummaries.place: An outdoor setting with a softly blurred blue-grey background suggesting open air and distant landscape or sky.

coverSummaries.description: A bright living room scene shows five young men arranged casually among furniture and objects. One sits on a sofa holding an acoustic guitar, one reclines on the wooden floor in the foreground, one sits near a television, and two stand or lean near the back windows; the room contains framed pictures, wine glasses, bottles, a fireplace, plants, and guitars.
coverSummaries.signatureMotif: man lying on the floor in a living room with bandmates around him
coverSummaries.people: five men posed around a living room, one lying on the floor and one holding a guitar
coverSummaries.place: A sunlit domestic living room with pale wooden floorboards, bay windows, a sofa, fireplace, television, plants, framed pictures, and scattered drinks and instruments.

coverSummaries.description: A surreal painted scene combines many symbolic objects in a pale mountain landscape under a cloudy sky. At the center floats a large yellow horned face with a moustache above a freestanding door; around it are a flying swallow, a giant eye in a jeweled frame, a red clawed hand, a skeletal hand, an hourglass, a shell, a playing card, a blue goat-like figure carrying a bundle, a small dog, and a balloon basket hanging from a human head partly hidden by clouds.
coverSummaries.signatureMotif: large yellow horned face floating above a door

coverSummaries.description: A sepia-toned composite image shows four young men standing in a row on top of a world map with latitude and longitude lines, beneath a cloudy sky. The figures wear dark, slim-fitting clothes; one has a wide-brim hat, one a beret and scarf, and their long shadows stretch across the map surface.
coverSummaries.signatureMotif: four men standing on a world map
coverSummaries.people: four men standing in a row in dark clothing
coverSummaries.place: A stylised map-like ground plane with continents and grid lines under a cloudy sky creates an unreal composite setting rather than a real location.

coverSummaries.description: A close-up, high-contrast image of a mannequin or medical dummy fills the frame against a black background. The head is tilted back with eyes closed and mouth open, and two round electrode pads are attached to the bare chest.
coverSummaries.signatureMotif: tilted-back mannequin face with electrode pads

coverSummaries.description: A mostly white studio-style cover places a group of eight men clustered in the lower right, photographed from a slightly elevated angle. They wear suits and ties in dark tones, with one in a hat and one with long dreadlocks, and they look upward toward the camera.
coverSummaries.signatureMotif: eight suited men grouped in the lower right on a white background
coverSummaries.people: eight men in suits standing together and looking up
coverSummaries.place: A seamless white studio backdrop and floor with no visible furniture or architectural features.

prompt: An old domestic living room at nightfall, photographed at eye level from conversational distance, medium close environmental portrait in a 16:9 frame. In the near middle ground stands the man from reference image 1, three-quarter length, front-on, in his suit, smiling and raising a cocktail glass toward the viewer, sharply lit and clearly recognisable. The room is the rebuilt place from reference image 4: pale wooden floorboards, sofa, fireplace, television, bay windows with darkness outside, framed pictures, and a few drinks on surfaces, with nobody else present. Add support details from reference image 5 as real objects in the room: a freestanding interior door standing oddly near the fireplace, a large framed eye hanging on the wall among the pictures, and a swallow ornament mounted or suspended near the upper wall. Add a support detail from reference image 6 as a sepia world-map floorcloth or painted map section laid across part of the wooden floor, subtle but recognisable. No lettering anywhere, no tattoo imagery, no extra people, no posters or album covers. Photographic realism, crisp editorial location photography. Warm evening wall sconces and fireplace glow light the room, with soft fill keeping the cast face bright and readable; clean shadows, no haze. Palette of cream, beige, black, white, sepia, and blue-grey window darkness; intimate, witty, gently surreal mood. Reference map for people (the album images are attached in this numbered order): reference image 1 shows one man in a suit holding up a cocktail glass, and reference image 9 is an enlarged close-up of those same people - take their faces from reference image 9. Copy each of these faces directly from that numbered reference image - same face, bone structure, hair, expression, and styling - rather than drawing a new person from the description. Nobody from reference images 2, 3, 4, 6, 8 appears in the picture: use those images only for colour, setting, and objects, and add no figures, faces, or silhouettes from them. Hard constraints (override any conflicting source material): Create a single cohesive 16:9 image, not a grid, contact sheet, row of covers, or collage of separate panels. Do not reproduce the album sleeves as framed thumbnails, posters, record covers, or pictures on a screen, monitor, or television. A sleeve's abstract graphics, shapes, patterns, and colours may be painted onto the walls, doors, floor, or objects of the place as part of its decoration, without any lettering. Show no sleeve's faces, heads, or figures as a picture, mural, display, sign, relief, or silhouette anywhere; transform the sleeves' non-text visual motifs into one original composition. Include no readable text or lettering of any kind: no words, letters, numbers, code, glyphs, captions, titles, logos, watermarks, labels, or signage. Feature only adults and avoid gore, wounds, body horror, medical or anatomical imagery, blank or milky eyes, nudity, sexual content, weapons, and hate symbols; reinterpret any sensitive source motif abstractly. When a source includes a person, closely match their visible appearance and likeness to the reference image, preserving recognisable facial features, hair, skin tone, clothing, and styling, and their apparent age: every person is shown as the adult they are on the sleeve, never younger, smoothed, or more boyish or girlish. Keep each reference person in the pose, expression, and gaze the sleeve shows, and keep every identifiable face sharp, lit, unobscured, and in focus: no motion blur, long-exposure smearing, steam, fog, shadow, crowding, or shallow depth of field over a reference person's face. Expose the image cleanly whatever the light: every person's face well lit and readable, shadows that hold detail, and clear colour, with no murky underexposure, crushed blacks, heavy film grain, digital noise, or dust-and-scratches texture. Add no incidental plants: no flowers, potted plants, planters, climbing vines, ivy, hanging foliage, hedges, lawns, flower beds, or greenery framing the edges or carpeting the floor, unless the description above explicitly asks for that plant as part of a source motif or the year treatment. Dress the scene with the materials of the place itself - stone, metal, concrete, wood, fabric, glass, water, equipment - rather than vegetation. Everyone in the picture is photographed in the same place, at the same moment, under the same light as the rest of the scene, in full colour and with the same lens and grain: do not carry over a sleeve's own backdrop, studio lighting, backlit flare, monochrome, colour cast, or print texture onto the person. Each person stands inside the scene at the scale of the space around them, never as an oversized cropped head or bust looming at the edge of the frame over a distant scene, and never washed in red, blue, or other coloured light. Depict each identifiable reference person only once in the entire composition; do not repeat or clone them as another figure, reflection, mirror portrait, poster, billboard, screen, photograph, painting, silhouette, or background face. The only exception is repetition visibly intrinsic to one source cover: keep that repetition within that single source motif and do not echo the person elsewhere. The only people anywhere in the image are the reference people named in the reference map, and of those only the ones whose faces are clearly visible in their reference. Add no one else: no extra band members, musicians, staff, bystanders, passers-by, crowd, audience, background or out-of-focus figures, and no hands, arms, legs, or shadows of unseen people. Never complete a person who is hidden, cropped, turned away, blurred, or only partly visible in a reference with an invented face or body - leave that person out entirely. Photograph the reference people from roughly eye level, at three-quarter length or closer, in the near or middle ground, so each of their faces is large, sharp, and clearly recognisable in the final frame: never from directly above, and never as small distant figures.
